text:
Anya: @channel tiny victory but huge — we just crossed $50M ARR this month 🎉 huge thanks to everyone! planning a quick rooftop + Zoom toast at 4:30 today. low-key snacks, louder dad jokes.

Sam: OMG congrats!!!! :raised_hands: this team is unstoppable.

Ben: confetti pls. also playlist? dropping a spotify link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcBWIGoYBM5M (feel free to add)

Lee: I’ll handle snacks — empanadas or bao? vote with emoji: 🍰 for cake, 🥟 for empanadas, 🧁 for cupcakes.

Olivia: I’m bringing my potted ficus as the official mascot 🌱 photo op? :camera_flash:

Maria: tiny trophy idea: golden mini server on a wooden base. @Jamal you are our maker — can you 3D print? :metal:

Jamal: on it. thinking LEDs that blink when we hit hourly requests threshold 😂 what color? blue, green, or disco?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Release v3.6 deployed to production. Health checks: green. No incidents reported.

Sasha: remote folks: could we get a $15 food stipend? also optional karaoke signup pls. name my song pick: 'Take On Me'.

Anya: yep stipend approved. calendar invite sent — rooftop + Zoom link. poll pinned: cake vs empanadas, react to vote 🍰 or 🥟. also please add 1-2 line shoutouts for the recognition email.

Ben: shoutout to infra team for the last-minute autoscale tweak — saved our bacon :clap:

Lee: shoutout to @Maria for rallying the rollout, and @Jamal for the LED trophy idea. tiny gifs incoming.

Olivia: gif: tiny ficus dancing (reaction: :tada: by Sam)

Sam: can't wait to see the plant. see y'all at 4:30 — photos for the #hall-of-fame channel pls :camera_with_flash:

Anya: photos or it didn't happen. :camera_flash:
